shared_elements: costume detail rendered by incised lines
justification: Both depict human figures in profile with headgear, carrying objects, and both use incised linear detail for garment/ornament, but that is about as generic as figural art gets. A shows a calm processional frieze of evenly spaced men leading a two-humped camel between rosette borders, while B shows a single dense, frontally massed figure with an enormous plumed/feathered headdress, ornaments and masks packed around it, with no procession, no animal, and no framing bands.
